entities.name: Menthol
observations: Decoded reactant: CC1CC(O)CC(C)(C)C1; a secondary cyclohexanol substrate with unspecified stereochemistry.

entities.name: Resorcinol-type dihydroxybenzene
observations: Decoded reactant: OC1=CC=CC(O)=C1; a dihydroxybenzene isomer, with regiochemistry described by the source as resorcinol-type.

entities.name: Menthyl aryl ether formation
observations: Likely mono-O-alkylation/etherification: one phenolic oxygen bonds to the menthyl carbon while the second phenolic OH remains free.
No exact empirical ORD precedent was found for this specific product core.
Most plausible inferred conditions are Mitsunobu etherification or, alternatively, alcohol activation as a sulfonate followed by phenoxide substitution.

entities.name: Mitsunobu etherification conditions
observations: Triphenylphosphine with DIAD or DEAD in THF or another aprotic solvent, typically 0 °C to room temperature, is the leading inferred reagent system.
Because menthol is secondary and hindered, activation as a mesylate or tosylate followed by K2CO3 or Cs2CO3-promoted phenoxide substitution is a plausible alternative.
